interface.title: Spatial Action Review — Autonomous EM Oversight
interface.field: AI evaluation for bioimage analysis (vision-language models on electron-microscopy images of mitochondria)
interface.stage_of_work: model evaluation and audit before a model's outputs are used in later steps; human review and sign-off
interface.what_it_is_for: Audit a vision-language model's paired MCQ answer and point predictions on EM image crops, find regions where the answer is right but the points are unusable (silent failures), and record and export a routing decision for each region reviewed.

data.note: Most work used the built-in 'Case study (541)' set (Qwen3-VL / Staged GRPO) and the 'SFT-variant audit (753)' set (5 conditions: Zero-shot, Perception SFT, Grounding SFT, Staged SFT, Joint SFT). I also uploaded the test files example_inspector_data.json (10 records) and example_crops.zip under 'Your own run'. All 10 crops matched (screens/034.webp, screens/035.webp). Downloads I read: audit_queue_Staged_GRPO_tau0.50.csv, routing_decisions.csv, routing_decisions.json and example_inspector_data.json.

tree.general: Find where a model's stated answer looks correct but the points it predicts on the image are unusable, and record a review decision for each case
tree.specific: Audit the language-to-action hand-off of Qwen3-VL on EM crops: find silent failures (A=1, Rτ=0), inspect crops with GT and predicted points, route each one (accept/escalate/hold/revise) and export the review log

features.name: 2×2 agreement ledger that builds a review queue
features.general: Cross-tabulate two pass/fail judgements on the same items into four clickable cells; clicking a cell fills a review queue with those items, and the cell counts update when the pass threshold moves
features.specific: Answer–action ledger: A(c) correct/wrong × Rτ(c) reliable/unreliable gives Aligned pass, Silent failure, Action-only pass and Blocked; clicking a cell sets the image-region audit queue
steps: read the four cell percentages and counts
click a cell (e.g. Silent failure)
the queue header updates to 'Queue: <state> · with crop image — N record(s)'
move τ to see the cells redistribute
serves_tasks: Pick an outcome category to review

features.name: Risk heatmap with click-to-filter toggle
features.general: Heatmap of a failure rate over two categorical axes, with n per cell and a hover tooltip; clicking a cell filters the downstream list and clicking it again clears the filter
features.specific: Risk map of silent-failure rate by task (presence/counting/location/relation/attribute) × dataset (Lucchi/VNC/EM-H); restricts the audit queue and works together with the ledger state
steps: scan for dark cells and note small-n warnings
hover a cell for VQA accuracy, mean recall and n
click the cell to restrict the queue
combine it with a ledger state (an empty combination shows a message)
click the cell again to clear
serves_tasks: See which question type and dataset concentrate the risk, and limit the queue to it

features.name: Image viewer with true and predicted points drawn over it, plus per-item scores
features.general: Step through a queue one item at a time; each image shows true locations and predicted points drawn on it, can be opened fullscreen, and sits next to the item's text answer and its scores
features.specific: Image-region audit: crop with GT centroids (green X) and predicted points (red rings), state banner, stray-action warning, Record / Language channel / Action channel tables (object recall, hit rate, point F1, gate verdict)
steps: press next › / ‹ prev to move through the queue
open the crop fullscreen
read the question, options, model answer and expected answer
read the point counts, recall and gate verdict
serves_tasks: Look at one image with the true and predicted locations drawn on it, alongside the model's answer and scores

features.name: Per-item decision buttons with a session log and export
features.general: Give each reviewed item one of a fixed set of decisions plus a free-text reason; decisions are stamped with time and the settings in force, can be replaced or cleared, are counted in a log that flags decisions made under different settings, and export as CSV or a self-describing JSON. Decisions live only in the current session and are not carried by a shared link
features.specific: Routing decision (Accept action / Escalate for expert review / Hold for a stricter gate / Flag for model revision) with reason, saved with τ and state; the Review log tab shows per-route totals, a stale-τ warning, a table, and Download decisions (CSV/JSON) / Clear all decisions. Known issue from the replay: routing_decisions.json writes context.queue_state as 'lucky' for the Action-only pass state instead of 'action_only'. Decisions are session-only: opening a shared URL starts at 0 signed off
steps: type an optional reason
press a route button
change or clear the decision
open the Review log to see totals and the stale-gate warning
download CSV or JSON
serves_tasks: Decide whether the model's predicted points may be used for the current item, and record the decision with an optional reason
Review all decisions and export them

features.name: Threshold slider with a sensitivity curve
features.general: One threshold slider recomputes every view; a companion line chart shows the two outcome rates across all threshold values, with the current threshold marked, plus a table of counts per threshold
features.specific: Action-reliability gate τ slider (0.05–0.95) plus the Threshold sensitivity tab: aligned-pass vs silent-failure rate, a dashed 'gate in force' line, and a table of actions cleared / held / silent-failure queue per τ
steps: drag the slider or use the arrow keys
watch the header statistics and ledger update
read the curve and hover the in-force dots
read the per-τ table
serves_tasks: See how outcome rates change across all thresholds

features.name: Upload your own results file and images
features.general: Upload a per-item results file (JSON) and an optional zip of images matched by ID; the tool lists the required and optional fields, reports how many images matched and which fields are missing, and recomputes every view; an example file pair can be downloaded
features.specific: Your own run (upload): inspector_data.json plus crop zip named <crop_id>.png, a schema card (crop_id, dataset, task, answer_correct, obj_recall, n_gt, n_pred), a matched-crops banner, an absent-fields notice (point_f1, pim_prec), and a 'Try it without a run of your own' example download
steps: choose Your own run
download the example files if needed
upload the JSON
upload the crops zip
read the match and missing-field banners, then audit as usual
serves_tasks: Upload your own model's results and images to audit them the same way

features.name: View state stored in the URL
features.general: The full view (data source, model variant, threshold, category, filter cell, selected item, theme) is kept in the URL so a link reopens the same view; a reset button restores defaults. Review decisions are not part of the link: opening it starts a fresh session with none recorded
features.specific: Query params source, condition, tau, state, risk_cell, record, theme; Reset run configuration (keeps theme). Decisions are session-only and not carried by the URL (screens/044.webp shows 0 signed off)
steps: adjust the view
copy the URL
open the URL to restore the view
press Reset run configuration to return to defaults
serves_tasks: Reopen an exact view from a link

features.name: Cross-condition comparison table with trust gap and confidence interval
features.general: One table that scores every model variant at the current threshold side by side: item count, answer accuracy, location recall, failure and pass rates, the conditional failure rate, and the gap between answer and location reliability with a bootstrap confidence interval
features.specific: Re-audit across conditions tab: per condition (Zero-shot, Perception SFT, Grounding SFT, Staged SFT, Joint SFT) n, VQA accuracy, object recall, silent failure, aligned pass, P(R|A), trust gap and CI low/high at the gate in force
steps: open the Re-audit across conditions tab
read accuracy, recall, silent-failure and aligned-pass rates per condition
compare trust gap and its CI across conditions to choose which variant to trust
serves_tasks: Compare model variants at the current threshold

features.name: Run-summary header
features.general: A header card that states what is being audited and the headline rates (accuracy, location recall, failure rate, conditional failure rate, gap with confidence interval, correlation) and recomputes when the data, variant or threshold changes
features.specific: Header with source, model, condition, gate definition, VQA accuracy, object recall, silent-failure rate, P(Rτ=0|A=1), trust gap with CI and point-biserial
steps: read the source, model, condition and gate in force
read the headline rates and the trust gap with its CI
change τ or condition and watch the figures update
serves_tasks: Read the run-level summary before drilling down

features.name: Uncovered-prediction (stray-point) warning
features.general: Counts predicted points that land on no true object, both for the whole selected group and for the current item, because a recall-only pass/fail test cannot see them
features.specific: Stray-action panel under the ledger ('N (x%) also emit at least one point that lands on no ground-truth object') and the per-record stray-action warning in the image-region audit
steps: read the group-level count of items with stray points
read the per-record warning while stepping through the queue
serves_tasks: Check for predicted points that land on no true object
